name: Hamilton Beach Brands
outlook:
What Hamilton Beach Brands says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenueBased on more cautious retailer inventory commitments amid a softer consumer outlook, the Company now expects fourth-quarter sales to be lower than previously anticipated. As a result, the Company now expects 2026 revenue to be flat year over year compared to prior guidance of growth approaching mid-single digit range.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
